text:
By rugged roads I have arrived
at a place where fear can move me not;
if I try to change or take a step,
I am dragged back by the hair.

Yet with death beside me, I seek
new counsel for my life;
I know the best, yet choose the worst,
by habit's fault or fate's command.

On the other side, my brief span,
the errant course of all my years,
at their beginning and their middle;

my bent, with which I cease to fight,
the certain death that ends so many ills,
make me neglect my own repair.

translation.title: By rugged roads I have arrived
